scope: Reconcile the nine rendered canonical textbook figure paths without recorded checksums in the previous root preview. Keep the actual reader images, paths, and source articles unchanged.

review.provenance: Eight local files are byte-identical to the downloaded publisher/course copies. GPQA and HLE additionally match the contents of the separately pinned licensed author figures. The SFT slide matches the pinned lecture source and PDF page 11 in text and code, but the current PDF renders with different fonts and wrapping.
review.rights: GPQA v1 and HLE v12: CC BY 4.0 on the papers. Lambert lecture source: MIT per the pinned project README, which places only book/chapters under CC BY-NC-SA. Six other byte-identical copies are explicitly unverified for redistribution; no rights inferred from visibility, the vLLM engine code license, or the user’s noncommercial intent.
review.lessonCheck: GPQA figure shows the first expert’s wrong blind answer, post-hoc agreement, author revision, second expert’s correct answer and the Diamond criterion. HLE v12 shows 2,500 public questions, compared with 3,000 in v1 and 2,700 in v3. In SFT, the separate rendered template is a model-specific text prefix and the last assistant marker is not an assistant answer.
review.preservation: Textbook chapters, figures and the Gordić source note are not edited. This is a provenance reconciliation, not a whole-chapter approval or permission to deploy.
review.validation: Astro built 2081 pages with zero broken internal routes, fragments or files. All 297 built-output and 204 registry, public-asset and reading-receipt tests passed. The 310 canonical locale pages expose 1215 distinct local figure paths, all matching a registry digest, including 44 byte-identical path aliases. In Chrome, all nine reconciled figures decoded and fit on the seven affected chapters at 375 and 1280 px in both locales (English fallback where no translation exists). The three licensed figures also zoomed and panned on mobile.
